prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: transparent vocabulary-card car illustration, intended display about 140 x 110 CSS pixels.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: gray-teal boxy car with Volvo text. Image 2 is the approved STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Use its warm dark-brown hand-drawn outlines, soft painterly paper-like color, subtle volume and approachable 2D children's storybook finish. Do not copy its people, classroom, background or vignette.
Primary request: Repaint the car from Image 1 as an illustration from the same children's picture book as Image 2. Preserve the muted gray-teal color and unmistakably boxy small estate/station-wagon silhouette. Remove the Volvo text. Single isolated car only.
Style: Highly readable 2D storybook gouache illustration with warmly colored, gently irregular dark-brown linework, soft matte paper-textured fills, restrained highlights and subtle painted shading. The finish should match the illustrated characters in Image 2, with similar simplicity and softness. Not photorealistic, not a glossy product render, not a 3D toy, not a crude geometric icon.
Perspective and subject: Whole car faces RIGHT. Almost side-on, with only a very slight front three-quarter turn showing a narrow glimpse of the front grille. Precisely TWO visible wheels: the near-side rear wheel and the near-side front wheel. Far-side wheels must be completely hidden behind the body; no extra tire fragments under the car. Boxy gray-teal body and roof, windows, two simple doors, subtle grille, headlights and a small intact side mirror. No occupants or logos.
Composition: Horizontal canvas. The car must be centered and must occupy ONLY 84% of canvas width. Reserve fully transparent margins of at least 8% at left and right, including the bumper and mirror. Plenty of clear space above and below. Entire wheels, mirror, bumpers and body fully within frame.
Background and edges: TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA BACKGROUND. Absolutely no backdrop, no brown glow, no atmosphere, no halo, no dark vignette, no spotlight, no colored haze or color outside the object. All pixels outside the car silhouette must be fully transparent, except ONE very small, low-opacity neutral gray-brown contact shadow immediately beneath the two tires. That shadow must stay narrow and local; never surround the car. Crisp clean alpha edges, no white sticker outline.
Text: None.
Constraints: No Volvo word, no writing, no letters, no numbers, no badge, no brand logo, no watermark, no people, no environment, no frame, no border, no added objects. One finished car illustration only.
